title: Bull, Bear and the Capital Decision: Exit, Monitor and Wait
web_title: 9. Bull, Bear and the Capital Decision: Exit, Monitor and Wait
book_title: Chapter 9: Bull vs. Bear, Likely Outcomes and the Exit Plan
question: What should you do with new money and with the 10,000 shares already in the portfolio?

web_blocks.text: The bull case is concrete. RNIT reported FY2026 revenue of ₹51.50 crore and PAT of ₹12.02 crore after ₹32.23 crore and ₹7.21 crore in FY2025. Q2 FY2027 revenue and profit continued to grow. The company has named engagements in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Meghalaya, a September 2026 APSSDC NIA award scoped at up to 20 lakh users/interview sessions, a five-year service term and usage-linked per-minute billing, and a broader identity and governance suite. If attendance, beneficiary verification and NIA become reusable products rather than separate implementation projects, revenue could scale faster than staff and consultancy costs. The award is classified above ₹25 crore under RNIT’s policy, but realized billing depends on actual usage and delivery acceptance; no completed-session or collection data are disclosed. A young business with access to state customers can have a real option value. [1] [3] [5] [6] [11] [12] [43]

The bear case is not that facial recognition or conversational AI has no market. It is that RNIT’s financial statements do not yet show which products produce sales, how much revenue recurs, which customers dominate, or whether deployments renew without bespoke effort. The annual report combines all offerings into one operating segment. FY2026 CFO was positive, but fixed/intangible purchases exceeded it; H1 FY2027 CFO turned negative while receivables rose and cash fell. Goodwill and intangibles are material, and the audited cash-flow bridge includes borrowing and tax-liability movements. A project pipeline can still fail at acceptance, collection or reuse. [1] [3]

The evidence-weighted 12-month scenarios use ₹110 in the bull case, ₹63 in the base case and ₹31.40 in the bear case, with probabilities of 20%, 55% and 25%. The probability-weighted value is ₹64.50, about 27.5% below the ₹88.99 last available ledger mark. The bull requires FY2027 EPS of ₹2.50 and a 44-times multiple; the base uses ₹1.80 at 35-times; the bear uses ₹1.00 at 31.4-times. The weights are judgment, not a historical frequency. They make the principal decision visible: at the current ledger mark, even a profitable base case does not pay you for the working-capital and multiple risk. [1] [3]

web_blocks.caption: Independent 12-month scenarios — the return case must be earned in cash as well as earnings
web_blocks.takeaway: The base value is below the monitoring band around ₹71.04–₹73.85, so support alone cannot establish a 1.5:1 reward/risk. The new-capital verdict is REJECTED rather than a hedged wait. Re-underwrite if cash conversion, product renewals and price structure all improve. [1] [3] [25]

web_blocks.text: The new-capital verdict is REJECTED. The business-quality assessment remains CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL, not FUNDAMENTAL_FAIL: there is a functioning service business, audited profit and customer evidence, but not yet enough proof of compounding software economics. A 56.7-times FY2026 EPS multiple and negative after-capex cash flow make the return hurdle too high. Even the lower monitor band near the base support leaves the base target below price. Do not average down because an indicator is oversold, and do not treat a government logo as a recurring contract. [1] [3] [22]

For the current holding, the same-session positions ledger records 10,000 shares in Zerodha, market value ₹889,900, cost basis ₹555,481.37, unrealized gain ₹334,418.63 and portfolio weight 20.78%, valued at the ₹88.99 last verified mark. The probability-weighted value is ₹64.50, 27.5% below that mark, while the bear case is ₹31.40; the chart inputs are not synchronized enough to supply a live stop. Retaining half would still leave about 10.39% of NAV exposed while new capital is rejected. I revise the action to EXIT_IMMEDIATELY: advisory exit all 10,000 at the next liquid opportunity after checking the live quote and tradability. This is not a broker order. [1] [3]

An exit at the ledger mark would release an estimated ₹889,900 before fees, but the price is one session stale and is not an execution quote. Existing portfolio cash of ₹318,497.13 remains separate until a trade occurs. A completed exit would close the position and avoid carrying a 20.78%-of-NAV exposure with a negative probability-weighted return and no reliable stop. RNITAI can be reconsidered only after accepted deployments, repeat revenue and cash conversion improve and a synchronized price series supports a new entry. [1] [3]

Redeployment compares two active shortlist names, one researched outside comparator and cash. COFORGE is in the active shortlist and the fact ledger still classifies it Stage 2, but its existing base target of ₹2,400 against the consumer snapshot’s support/invalidation structure yields less than 1.5:1 at the top of the buy band; it receives 0% today. Manorama Industries has a valid Stage 2 profile and a stronger base-case ratio at its support band, but its ₹2,100.10 ledger close was 2.22 ATR above the 50-DMA after a 2.36× volume day, so it is not a chase. eMudhra is a direct identity/trust comparator but its last bar is below key averages and the ledger labels it Stage 1; its conservative target remains below the current value. None clears all gates now. [22] [25] [33]

The 100% review allocation therefore remains cash until a named equity candidate is both at a valid entry and supported by current business evidence. The plan is 0% COFORGE, 0% Manorama, 0% eMudhra and 100% cash. For the conditional shortlist rows, the base target and asymmetry ratio are shown for comparison, but no proceeds are reserved as an order. The exact conditions are: COFORGE re-enters its snapshot support band with at least 1.5:1 reward/risk on a fresh report; Manorama returns to its 1W/1D support band without a Stage 2 breakdown; eMudhra forms a Stage 1 base and reclaims a rising 50-DMA. Until then, cash is the only fully evidenced destination. [25] [33]

A positive reassessment needs a sequence, not one headline. The next reviewed annual accounts should show CFO at least recovering toward PAT, lower receivables older than one year and a clear bridge from contract assets to cash. The company should disclose renewal or subscription share, customer concentration and product-level sales, while repeat deployments should reduce consultancy effort relative to revenue. A fresh, synchronized price series should also reclaim the rising 50-DMA and establish Stage 2 rather than remain in a pullback. If only the stock price rises, the business thesis has not improved; if only earnings rise while cash deteriorates, the quality gate remains open. [1] [3]

Before any future RNITAI re-entry, require audited CFO to recover toward PAT, aged receivables to convert, recurring revenue or renewals to be disclosed, and accepted deployments to demonstrate reuse. A close below ₹73.85 and the 200-DMA near ₹71.04 would weaken the structural chart but is not an automatic short or buy signal. Rebuild valuation and risk sizing from a synchronized completed-session data set before reconsidering exposure. These are analyst review triggers, not broker instructions. [1] [3] [25]

epigraph.quote: Know what you own, and know why you own it.
epigraph.author: Peter Lynch, investor maxim [37]

book_paragraphs: You and I can accept both sides of the argument without pretending they cancel each other. RNIT has reported rising revenue and profit, a suite of identity and governance products, and named engagements with state customers. It has also reported negative half-year operating cash flow, rising receivables, a small post-relisting earnings history and no product-level economics. The central question is not whether the product demos look promising; it is whether each deployment becomes a profitable, recurring and collected stream. [1] [3]

The bull case begins with proof of execution. FY2026 revenue was ₹51.50 crore and PAT was ₹12.02 crore. Q2 FY2027 revenue was ₹16.41 crore and the half-year produced ₹5.51 crore PAT. A large public-sector customer can create credibility for follow-on projects, while identity, attendance, education and NIA modules may share technical infrastructure. Management also reported high-volume facial identifications in its presentation. If customers renew and the codebase is reused, the small reported scale can create operating leverage. [1] [3] [7]

The bear case begins where the optimistic story tends to stop. The company does not disclose SaaS revenue share, paid active users, renewal rates, product margins, top-customer concentration, deployment cost or cohort economics. One segment combines design, development, consulting, maintenance and platforms. The auditor highlighted milestone completion and customer acceptance as key revenue judgments. H1 FY2027 then showed positive profit alongside negative operating cash flow, a larger receivable balance and materially lower cash. The business may be growing; the public record has not yet shown whether growth self-funds. [1] [3]

I assign 20% to the bull case, 55% to base and 25% to bear. The bull value of ₹110 assumes EPS ₹2.50 and a 44x multiple; the base ₹63 assumes ₹1.80 and 35x; the bear ₹31.40 assumes ₹1.00 and 31.4x. The weighted price is ₹64.50, which is approximately 27.5% below the ₹88.99 last available ledger mark. This is not a claim of statistical precision. It expresses the fact that failure to scale can hurt more than current-year earnings imply, while a successful platform can retain meaningful upside. [1] [3]

Because the base value is below the support-monitor band, new money is rejected. A technically oversold stock can bounce, but that is not the same as a business becoming a compounder. Nor does a single quarter of growth prove a subscription model. New capital becomes eligible only after three tests align: more transparent product and customer economics, audited cash conversion that catches up with profit, and a share-price structure that recovers into a durable Stage 2 rather than merely touching support. [1] [3] [25]

The current holding deserves a separate portfolio decision because it represents 20.78% of NAV. The ledger records 10,000 shares, a market value of ₹889,900, cost of ₹555,481.37 and unrealized profit of ₹334,418.63. The probability-weighted value is ₹64.50 versus ₹88.99, a 27.5% downside. Retaining 5,000 shares would leave about 10.39% of NAV exposed without a synchronized stop, while new capital is rejected. I therefore revise the action to EXIT_IMMEDIATELY and advise selling all 10,000 shares at the next liquid opportunity after checking the live quote. [1] [3]

At the last verified mark, the estimated exit proceeds are ₹889,900 before costs; the one-session data gap means this is not an execution price. Existing cash remains separate until a trade settles. If the company later shows accepted, repeatable deployments and operating cash that catches up with profit, you can rebuild the thesis from zero. Until then, a profitable past position does not need to remain a 20.78%-of-NAV exposure. [1] [3] [25]

We also examined alternative places for the freed capital. COFORGE remains a shortlist Stage 2 name, yet its current base target and support/invalidation range do not clear the mandated reward/risk hurdle; Manorama has better support-zone asymmetry but sits 2.22 ATR above its 50-DMA after a high-volume up day; eMudhra is an outside identity peer with a weaker Stage 1 base and a conservative value below its current quote. That leaves no immediate equity destination. Keep the entire proceeds in cash, and reassess only when a candidate meets both evidence and entry conditions. [22] [25] [33]

This is where Howard Marks’s reminder, “You can't predict. You can prepare,” becomes practical. Prepare for the business to deliver: demand customer acceptance, renewal data, receivable collections and a clear segment bridge. Prepare for the bear case too: set the point at which working-capital dependence or impairment changes the residual holding. There is no listed options chain to cap loss cheaply; the risk must be managed through position size, price discipline and fresh evidence. [3] [35]

You should not confuse the recommended trim with a final verdict on the technology. Facial matching, citizen-service workflows and multilingual conversational tools can address genuine operational needs. The valuation case fails because the public record has not yet proved that the revenues are recurring and the cash is real enough to support today’s multiple. Better disclosure can change this assessment. Until then, the report’s stance is explicit: exit the existing RNITAI position after checking live liquidity, reject new capital, and reconsider only when cash conversion and repeat deployments improve. [1] [3] [5] [6]

book_callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION — Protect the portfolio before predicting the company
book_callouts.text: You do not need to decide that the business will fail in order to decide that a 20.78% position is too large for the evidence presently available.
